name: SilverStar NRF24 fragment envelope

crc.name: CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE
crc.input: complete original logical datagram, without envelope

hardware_crc: Nordic 16-bit CRC protects each physical packet address/control/payload
ordering: out-of-order fragments allowed; interleaving replacement requires fragment zero
sequence_wrap: sender increments volatile session when u16 sequence wraps; no identity rollover
restart: local recovery flushes hardware FIFOs, drops pending TX and incomplete RX; peer duplicate history expires
publication: complete length and metadata agree, every fragment present and logical CRC verified
receipt: all physical fragments completed TX_DS; not proof of logical peer consumption or business ACK
security: no authentication; CRC collisions and complete stale datagram replay across history expiry are NOT PROVEN
cross_restart_partial_isolation: NOT PROVEN: volatile session1 repeats. Complete CRC can collide for old/new/mixed frames. FIFO order and bounded prompt owner service are assumptions; no successful isolation claim follows from CRC16 or 250ms history alone.
application: AIR M0 bytes unchanged; no automatic replay of business commands

assembly_expiry.refresh: Only a previously absent valid fragment refreshes inactivity; duplicates never extend either deadline.
assembly_expiry.clock: uint32 millisecond subtraction; caller services within half the counter range.
